preprocessing.description: Retain all 179 original shapeID feature identities and all polygon coordinates/components/holes unchanged. Map shapeName to name; sourceParentId=null because no native ADM1 field is supplied. CRS84 WGS84 values require no numeric conversion. Common pinned generator alone intersects coarse parents. No simplification, snap, repair, synthetic fill, global IDs or publication.
